pages.text: Somewhere in every trial chamber a heavy core sits locked in a Whirling Cage at the heart of a sealed arena, and the wind around it has learned to fight. Break the cage and the core rises, gathers the storm and lets loose a Hurricane: what the Wildfire is to the Blaze, this is to the Breeze.
The cage is all that keeps the core quiet. Whoever breaks it open had better be ready for what it was holding down.

It keeps its distance and never stands still. It hurls its fist where it expects you to be, hard enough to tear a shield from your hands; it gathers a cyclone above its head and flings it after you; and it leaps across the arena to land with a crushing smash. Every blow you land answers with a gust that throws you back, and arrows only bounce off its hide.
Wind charges and falls cannot harm it, and it will not leave its arena on its own. Bring it down and it leaves behind its heavy core, a handful of breeze rods and wind charges, and a treasure pouch.
